content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: hosted-inference / queue-depth-spike (severity: P1)
pagerduty-bot: Escalation policy: inference-critical -> primary oncall -> secondary -> manager
rachel: getting the page now. noticed surge in request queue length and request timeouts, started ~02:07 UTC
tom: confirm. queue depth 4x normal, some worker pods showing OOM restarts.
anita: traces show long stalls at kv-fetch layer, p95 degenerated to ~950ms for seq>1024.
rachel: primary oncall acked but then lost connection; PD shows primary's ack flipped to unacked after 30s, policy auto-escalated to secondary -> manager.
pagerduty-bot: Escalated to secondary oncall (tom) at 02:10 UTC
tom: i'm on it. pulling pod logs and scaling pools.
```
$ kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=worker -o wide
NAME                         READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
worker-abc123                 1/1     Running   3          22m
worker-def456                 0/1     CrashLoop 5          14m
```

$ kubectl -n inference logs worker-def456 --previous | tail -n 50
panic: runtime: out of memory
...
ERROR kvclient: read timeout after 10s
```

anita: looks like a memory regression in the new cache eviction logic. started with today's autoscale + cache driver changes.
rachel: mitigation idea: 1) disable new eviction; 2) scale up a temporary pool with older image; 3) circuit-break long requests to fallback variant.
tom: applying step 1 now. toggling config flag in config-service.
```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags/cache-eviction-new/disable -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```

tom: flag flip accepted, rolling restart of workers triggered.
anita: after restart, some pods recovered, queue depth dropping. p95 down to 420ms, errors still elevated at 0.9% but trending down.
pagerduty-bot: Manager escalation: manager paged (unacked) at 02:11 UTC
rachel: manager alerted (oncall manager is anita). anita, do you want a bridge?
anita: not yet. watching. if tail doesn't stabilise in 5m i'll request bridge.

rachel: customer impact: batch indexing jobs to S3 experienced timeouts for ~8 minutes, affecting 3 enterprise customers' nightly pipelines. real-time API clients saw higher tail latency but no durable failures.
tom: i've opened a customer incident ticket draft; rachel can review.
anita: note on PD behavior: we saw primary ack flip to unacked then immediate escalation; PD audit shows an incoming webhook for acknowledgement loss from mobile client -> session expired. filing PD support ticket to verify ack stability and to extend the primary silence window for this policy.
rachel: good catch. file the ticket and attach PD logs.

anita: mitigation complete at 02:25 UTC. queue stabilized, OOMs stopped.
pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by manual mitigation. state: resolved at 02:25 UTC

rachel: immediate follow-ups:
- anita: root-cause PR for cache eviction fix + revert toggle in prod
- tom: add chaos tests for memory regression to CI
- rachel: customer comms and post-incident summary
- ops: PagerDuty policy timing audit + make primary silence window configurable per policy

anita: creating PR now (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/1987).
tom: adding CI test plan to ticket.
rachel: i'll compile timeline and postmortem; handoff to tom for tracking follow-ups after 03:00 UTC. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
